summaryNote: This is the current TCG Forbidden & Limited List and is what governs the NAWCQ 2026 main event. No Chaos Origins (CORI) cards are Forbidden, Limited, or Semi-Limited as of this list — the set released 2026-07-02, after this list took effect. This page lists the notable headline changes from the May 18, 2026 update, not the full exhaustive list — always cross-check the official Konami list before locking in your deck list.
otherFormatsNote: NAWCQ side events include a Genesys-format tournament (points system, Link/Pendulum monsters excluded) and a Speed Duel Limited List event — these use different card pools than the main Advanced Constructed event and are not covered on this page.
